results.description: Mitchell Starc wants to continue his Test career after taking 10 wickets in Australia’s win over Bangladesh at Mackay, ahead of the South Africa tour.

results.title: "We Needed To Bounce Back": Pat Cummins Praises 'Sharp' Australia After Big Win Over Bangladesh In 2nd Test
results.description: Australia captain Pat Cummins praised his side for "all looking sharp" in a crushing innings and 51-run thrashing of Bangladesh in Mackay on Sunday as they emphatically bounced back from losing the first Test.
